claim_summary: Independent outlet reports unauthorized access to one Braintrust AWS account holding customer-stored AI provider API keys; company asked every customer to rotate stored keys and said it had communicated with one impacted customer
availability: incident reported contained by vendor; cause under investigation at publication
limitation: Detection date 2026-05-04 is taken from SecurityWeek/Security Affairs citing the vendor notice, not from TechCrunch; vendor Trust Center notice did not render for this screen; spokesperson wording disputes the term breach; root cause not found

product: Braintrust hosted platform (stored AI provider keys)
source_title: AI Firm Braintrust Prompts API Key Rotation After Data Breach
claim_summary: Second outlet reports discovery on 2026-05-04, customer email on 2026-05-05, one affected customer and three reporting suspicious provider-usage spikes, and links the vendor notice at trust.braintrust.dev/updates
availability: same incident as CI2026-055-004; investigation ongoing at publication
limitation: Same single event as row 004, not an independent second incident; scope figures are vendor-notice statements relayed by press; third-party customer-name speculation in coverage is not attributed to Braintrust and is not recorded here

source_title: Automate pattern discovery with Topics, now generally available
claim_summary: Vendor declares Topics GA on every plan: continuous classification of production traces into named clusters with built-in Task/Issues/Sentiment facets, custom facets and SQL-queryable labels usable for datasets and online scoring
availability: vendor GA; monthly credits then per-token overage
limitation: Cluster quality and failure-detection recall not independently measured; changelog May 2026 shows Topics pricing changed (launch promotion) so cost terms are dated

source_title: How we made continuous trace intelligence possible at scale
claim_summary: Vendor explains Topics pipeline: LLM facet summary then 1024-dim embeddings, HDBSCAN with UMAP by default on up to 50000 sampled facets, nearest-centroid classification without an LLM call, facet extraction on a Braintrust-managed Gemma model hosted on Baseten
availability: describes the GA feature in row 006
limitation: Engineering self-description; zero-data-retention and HIPAA statements are vendor claims not independently audited; minimum 400 traces limits small projects

source_title: autoevals py-0.3.0
claim_summary: MIT-licensed autoevals 0.3.0 (Python and JS tags same day) adds LiteLLM gateway option, zod 3/4 support and moves from the legacy proxy to the Braintrust gateway; several first-time external contributors credited
availability: GitHub release; MIT license per repository metadata
limitation: External first-time contributions show participation, not verified downstream reuse; default endpoint change affects reproducibility of earlier scores

source_title: Agent observability for startups
claim_summary: Vendor announces 6-12 months of Pro plan access for eligible startups (12 months if funded by named partner VCs at Series A or earlier), applications approved on a rolling basis
availability: program announced; eligibility gated
limitation: Commercial incentive, not evidence of adoption or usefulness; partner-VC list includes Braintrust investors

source_title: Faster phrase search with shingled bloom filters in Brainstore
claim_summary: Vendor reports trigram shingles in Brainstore bloom filters let phrase queries prune 63 of 64 segments on a ~290 GB customer-data slice, claiming more than 25x efficiency
availability: post gives no deployment/version scope; changelog lists shingled search for self-hosted data plane
limitation: Single vendor benchmark on undisclosed customer data; no independent replication; energy not measured

source_title: Behavior specs, an open standard for supervising long-horizon agents
claim_summary: Braintrust and Basis publish behavior specs: Markdown files under .agents/behaviors/ describing intended trajectory behavior, graded per trace as true/false/NA by a judge; spec, examples and judge prompt at agentbehavior.dev
availability: published standard; GitHub repo braintrustdata/agentbehavior is Apache-2.0 (created 2026-06-08)
limitation: Blog and site state no license; license taken from GitHub repo metadata only; no versioned spec number or independent adopter evidence found

source_title: Trace and improve Cloudflare Agents
claim_summary: Vendor documents tracing Cloudflare Agents via OTLP export from Workers Observability or JS wrappers for Agents SDK, ai-chat, think and Flue with stated minimum versions
availability: integration documented; no stage label
limitation: Cloudflare-side feature availability not checked on Cloudflare primary source; no independent trace-completeness test

source_title: Sandboxed agent evals with Harbor
claim_summary: Vendor announces a native Braintrust plugin for Harbor (Docker-sandboxed agent task framework from the terminal-bench team) syncing jobs into datasets, experiments, verifier-derived scores and ATIF trajectories, with backfill and host-only API key
availability: plugin documented; no preview/GA label stated
limitation: Harbor license and maintainer not verified on Harbor's own repository; verifier rewards are task-author defined, not independent acceptance

source_title: Use Braintrust with your coding agent
claim_summary: Vendor announces streamable-HTTP MCP server (US/EU endpoints, API key or OAuth 2.0) letting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients query traces with SQL, build/run evals and configure Topics, monitors and alerts
availability: documented; release stage not stated
limitation: Write tools act with the authenticated account's permissions; dataset deletions permanent; no independent security review

source_title: @braintrust/otel@1.0.0
claim_summary: OpenTelemetry bridge package promoted to semver 1.0.0 with no breaking changes; same-day 1.0.0 tags for temporal, browser, nunjucks-templates and deepseek-harness packages
availability: GitHub release; Apache-2.0 repository
limitation: A 1.0 version label is a stability signal from the vendor, not evidence of API stability or downstream use

source_title: One connected system for agent observability
claim_summary: Vendor announces Patterns (scheduled Loop investigations surfacing recurring failures with trace evidence), Debugger (per-trace failure-mode suggestions) and enhanced Loop that can edit prompts, scorers, datasets and run evals with approval
availability: public preview; pricing to follow before GA
limitation: Findings are LLM-generated hypotheses; docs say unavailable repo/MCP context yields hypotheses not confirmed causes; no independent precision/recall evaluation

source_title: Eval agent responses with Jev

availability: access-gated; not enabled by default
limitation: Jev license/open-source status not stated; judge calibration not independently validated

source_title: Your questions about Patterns, Topics, and Loop, answered
claim_summary: Vendor FAQ says Patterns has no Braintrust-side charge during public preview beyond inference and states plans to connect external systems and to add an agents abstraction below the project level
availability: stated intention without date
limitation: Intentions are uncommitted and undated; preview pricing will change

source_title: Faster queries for debugging production agents with Nitro
claim_summary: Vendor announces Nitro async query engine for Brainstore, enabled for all SaaS/BYOC customers and self-hosted from data plane 2.15; reports a 3-day production A/B with full-text search more than 2x faster and other queries 15 percent faster
availability: enabled by vendor; self-hosted version-gated
limitation: Vendor-run benchmarks with anonymized competitors; one competitor omitted for incorrect results; not independently replicated; no energy measurement

source_title: braintrust@3.37.0
claim_summary: Release adds cooperative eval cancellation via signal (eval now waits for in-flight tasks and scorers instead of leaving them running) and batch tasks/scorers for workflow evals
feature: eval timeout semantics and batch evals
availability: GitHub release; workflow evals labelled public preview in changelog
limitation: Behavior change of timeouts can alter eval wall-clock and cost; no independent test

source_title: Optimizing coding agent usage and costs
claim_summary: Vendor announces dashboard tracing coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity, Grok via bt) by developer, model, tool, branch or key, with daily Topics/Loop analysis feeding Patterns
availability: public preview for SaaS/BYOC; self-hosted from data plane 2.13
limitation: Costs derived from traced calls may differ from provider bills; per-developer breakdown raises consent/privacy questions not addressed in post

source_title: Application logs and agent traces in one view

limitation: No limits or pricing stated; preview may change; storage of application logs widens data-retention surface
